answer:
Configure a 2D transient, incompressible, laminar flow-past-a-cylinder simulation using pimpleFoam with a mesh that is exactly one cell thick in the spanwise (z) direction.
In constant/polyMesh/boundary, define the frontAndBack patches with type empty.
In 0/U, set the boundary condition for frontAndBack to type empty, with no value entry.
In 0/p, set the boundary condition for frontAndBack to type empty, with no value entry.
Apply type empty to frontAndBack in all other field files under 0/ (such as 0/p_rgh if present, or any transported scalars), with no value entries.
Leave the inlet boundary condition on U as uniformInletVelocity (or equivalent fixed uniform velocity) and on p as fixedValue or inletOutlet, as already configured for the flow-past-cylinder case.
Leave the outlet boundary condition on U as inletOutlet (zeroGradient fallback) and on p as fixedValue 0, as already configured.
Leave the cylinderWall boundary condition on U as noSlip and on p as zeroGradient, as already configured.
Set transportModel to Newtonian in constant/transportProperties; do not include a turbulence model (RASModel or LESModel) since the case is laminar.
Set the solver in system/controlDict to application pimpleFoam; the simulation is transient with a user-defined deltaT and endTime appropriate for the target Reynolds number.
Do not modify inlet, outlet, or cylinderWall boundary conditions in any file; only the frontAndBack patches across all relevant files are changed to empty.
